retrievalProfile.description: A framed retro layout featuring a heavy slab-serif header over a lo-fi studio photograph with a map background.
triggerTerms: heavy slab serif header on red border

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition defined by a thick red outer border containing a centered header in heavy white slab-serif type. Inside the border, a framed photograph shows two subjects in a cluttered, low-budget studio set against a simplified map graphic.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy white header text contrasting against a vibrant red border
A thin black inner stroke separating the red frame from the central image
Subjects positioned symmetrically in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Graphic map background interacting with secondary red text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures seated at a table, occupying the middle ground and scaled to fill the width of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold white header at the top of the red border acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top header down to the subjects' faces, then to the cluttered foreground objects, and finally to the background map text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects, props, and background graphics.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue (map background) and black (inner frame and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border contrasting with the more muted, earthy tones of the photographic subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is scaled to match the cap height of the surrounding letters

composition.position: Top center of the red border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy slab-serif header with a secondary, more spaced-out sans-serif or slab-serif inside the image frame for a 'labeled' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and blocky terminals.
Provides the necessary vintage geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thick red border. Inside the border, place a photograph of two people in winter gear sitting at a table with bottles and mugs, set against a simplified blue map on a pinkish wall. Apply a slight 1980s film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered header in the top red border using an extra-bold white slab-serif font. Add secondary red text inside the image frame, centered over the background map.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thick and prominent?
Is the header text a heavy white slab-serif?
Is there a thin black line separating the border from the photo?
Does the photo have a lo-fi, vintage studio quality?

mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original actors
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered in the top border.
Check that the red of the border matches the red of the internal text.
Verify the photographic grain is consistent across the inner frame.
Confirm the slab-serif font has no rounded corners.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square frame + Thick Red Border + White Slab-Serif Header + Lo-fi Studio Photo + Map Background = Retro Comedy Aesthetic
